scene_description: Two children are playing on a sandy beach. One child is pouring water from a red bucket onto a sandcastle decorated with small colorful flags. The ocean and blue sky are visible in the background.

questions.evidence_hint: Look at the bucket one child is holding.

questions.question: Who is playing in this picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people in the picture.

questions.question: Where are the children playing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground under the children and the water behind them.

questions.question: What is on top of the sandcastle?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the top of the big pile of sand.
